entries.title: See what connecting Google shares before you sign in
entries.body: Connecting Google in Settings → Integrations now first shows which Gmail and Calendar details Infinitary uses and where they go: your AI provider, another computer that runs your work, and your saved tasks. Google's sign-in page opens only after you accept.

picture.alt: Integrations shows the notice Before you connect Google, listing what Gmail and Calendar details are used and where they go, above Accept and continue to Google and Cancel.
